predecessors.name: Duchy of Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg
predecessors.text: the Hildburghausen share of the Saxe-Gotha division 'among his seven surviving sons' on 24 February 1680

successors.name: Duchy of Saxe-Meiningen
successors.text: 'everything else' after the 1826 rearrangement; the infobox says 'Passed to Saxe-Meiningen: 1826'

successors.name: Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha
successors.text: the districts of Königsberg and Sonnefeld, 'lost ... to the new Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha'

ledger.x: 24 February 1680: Saxe-Hildburghausen is carved out of Saxe-Gotha.
12 November 1826: Königsberg and Sonnefeld go to Coburg and Gotha.
12 November 1826: the rest of Saxe-Hildburghausen passes to Saxe-Meiningen.
12 November 1826: the duchy of Saxe-Hildburghausen ends.

certainty.note: A small Ernestine duchy of districts; the page gives district names and dates, no boundaries or area.
